content.prompt:
Draw the following on the number line.
$$[-2,3)$$

answer.worked: The square bracket includes $-2$ and the round bracket excludes 3. Join a filled dot at $-2$ to an open circle at 3.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis labelled −3 through 4; raised segment from filled −2 to open 3.
